SELECT t1.code_module, AVG(t2.score) 
FROM assessments AS t1 
JOIN studentAssessment AS t2 ON t1.id_assessment = t2.id_assessment 
JOIN studentInfo AS t3 ON t1.code_module = t3.code_module AND t1.code_presentation = t3.code_presentation AND t2.id_student = t3.id_student 
WHERE t1.assessment_type = 'TMA' AND t3.final_result IN ('Pass', 'Distinction') 
GROUP BY t1.code_module;
